# Sentry
> Application performance monitoring and error tracking for developers to detect, diagnose, and resolve software issues faster.

Sentry provides error monitoring, tracing, logs, replay, profiling, cron and uptime monitoring, plus developer tooling and integrations across many languages and frameworks.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://docs.sentry.io/): Main documentation hub for Sentry products, SDKs, setup, and platform guides.
- [Developer Documentation](https://develop.sentry.dev/): Internal and contributor-focused docs for Sentry architecture, APIs, and development workflows.
- [Product Documentation](https://docs.sentry.io/product/): Overview of Sentry product capabilities, concepts, and feature documentation.
- [Account and Billing](https://docs.sentry.io/account/): Documentation for organizations, teams, authentication, plans, and billing management.
- [Security and Privacy](https://docs.sentry.io/security-legal-pii/): Guidance on data security, privacy, PII handling, and compliance-related settings.
- [CLI Documentation](https://docs.sentry.io/cli/): Reference and guides for the Sentry command-line interface and release workflows.

## Product Areas
- [Error Monitoring](https://sentry.io/product/error-monitoring/): Capture exceptions, stack traces, and issue context to debug application failures.
- [Tracing](https://sentry.io/product/tracing/): Monitor distributed transactions, latency, and performance bottlenecks across services.
- [Logs](https://sentry.io/product/logs/): Centralize logs with application context for faster investigation and troubleshooting.
- [Session Replay](https://sentry.io/product/session-replay/): Reconstruct user sessions to understand frontend issues and user impact.
- [Profiling](https://sentry.io/product/profiling/): Analyze code-level performance hotspots with continuous and transaction-linked profiling.
- [Cron Monitoring](https://sentry.io/product/cron-monitoring/): Track scheduled jobs, missed runs, and failures in recurring tasks.
- [Uptime Monitoring](https://sentry.io/product/uptime-monitoring/): Check endpoint availability and alert on downtime or degraded service.
- [Size Analysis](https://sentry.io/product/size-analysis): Inspect bundle size changes and identify regressions in shipped assets.

## AI and Developer Tools
- [Seer](https://sentry.io/product/seer/): AI-assisted investigation features for understanding and resolving issues faster.
- [AI Code Review](https://sentry.io/product/seer/ai-code-review/): Automated code review tooling focused on quality and issue prevention.
- [Sentry CLI](https://cli.sentry.dev/): Command-line tool for releases, source maps, debugging artifacts, and automation.
- [Sentry MCP](https://mcp.sentry.dev/): Model Context Protocol tooling for connecting Sentry context to AI workflows.
- [Source Maps](https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/sourcemaps/): Upload and manage source maps for readable JavaScript stack traces.
- [Releases](https://docs.sentry.io/product/releases/): Track deployments, commits, regressions, and issue health across releases.

## SDKs and Platforms
- [JavaScript](https://sentry.io/for/javascript/): Sentry monitoring and debugging tools for JavaScript applications and services.
- [Python](https://sentry.io/for/python/): Error and performance monitoring for Python applications and frameworks.
- [React](https://sentry.io/for/react/): Frontend monitoring, replay, and performance tooling for React applications.
- [Laravel](https://sentry.io/for/laravel/): Exception tracking and performance monitoring for Laravel applications.
- [Platform Documentation](https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/): Entry point for all supported SDKs, frameworks, and platform-specific setup guides.
- [Mobile Platforms](https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/?platform=mobile): Documentation for mobile SDKs including iOS, Android, Flutter, and React Native.
- [Frontend Platforms](https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/?platform=javascript): Documentation for browser and JavaScript framework SDKs.
- [Backend Platforms](https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/?platform=python): Documentation for backend SDKs and server-side integrations.

## API and Reference
- [API Overview](https://docs.sentry.io/api/): Overview of Sentry APIs, authentication, resources, and usage patterns.
- [REST API Reference](https://docs.sentry.io/api/): Reference for organization, project, issue, event, and release endpoints.
- [Sentry SDK API Docs](https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/): SDK-specific configuration, APIs, and instrumentation reference.
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.sentry.io/cli/): Commands, flags, authentication, and automation workflows for sentry-cli.
- [Open Source Repositories](https://github.com/getsentry): Source code for Sentry server, SDKs, and related developer tools.
- [Developer API and Internals](https://develop.sentry.dev/): Architecture, service internals, and development references for contributors.

## Guides and Concepts
- [Getting Started](https://docs.sentry.io/product/sentry-basics/): Introductory concepts for projects, issues, alerts, and core Sentry workflows.
- [Alerting](https://docs.sentry.io/product/alerts/): Configure issue, metric, and uptime alerts for proactive incident response.
- [Issue Management](https://docs.sentry.io/product/issues/): Understand grouping, ownership, suspect commits, and triage workflows.
- [Performance Monitoring](https://docs.sentry.io/product/performance/): Concepts and setup for transaction monitoring and performance analysis.
- [Session Replay Docs](https://docs.sentry.io/product/explore/session-replay/): Documentation for replay setup, privacy controls, and debugging workflows.
- [Profiling Docs](https://docs.sentry.io/product/profiling/): Concepts and implementation guidance for application profiling.
- [Crons Docs](https://docs.sentry.io/product/crons/): Setup and manage cron monitors, schedules, and failure detection.
- [Uptime Docs](https://docs.sentry.io/product/uptime/): Configure uptime checks, monitor endpoints, and investigate outages.

## Integrations
- [Integrations Directory](https://sentry.io/integrations/): Browse available integrations for source control, chat, deployment, and workflow tools.
- [GitHub Integration](https://sentry.io/integrations/github/): Connect GitHub for commits, pull requests, suspect commits, and code mapping.
- [Slack Integration](https://sentry.io/integrations/slack/): Send alerts and issue context into Slack channels and workflows.
- [Source Control Integrations](https://docs.sentry.io/product/integrations/source-code-mgmt/): Configure repository providers for commits, ownership, and suspect commit features.
- [Alert Integrations](https://docs.sentry.io/product/integrations/notification-incidents/): Connect notification tools for alert delivery and incident response.
- [Deployment Integrations](https://docs.sentry.io/product/integrations/deployment/): Link deployment systems to releases and environment tracking.
